name: Fleximize Applications API
description:
Welcome to the Fleximize API!


**Important Notice:**


By submitting application, you confirm that you have obtained the consent of
all individuals associated with it (directors, personal guarantors,
mortgagors and shareholders etc). The personal information we have collected
from you will be shared with fraud prevention agencies. This is to prevent
fraud and money laundering and to verify the identity of all individuals
supplied and associated with this application. If fraud is detected, you and
these individuals could be refused certain services, finance and employment.
Further details on the processing of information and the individual’s data
processing rights can be found [here](https://www.cifas.org.uk/fpn).  



### Integration notes:  


* When onboarding, please ensure you set the “***is_test***” flag to “***true***” and only set it to “***false***” when you are ready to send live leads. Setting the flag to true will send applications to Fleximize's production database, but automatically mark the application as a test, and prevent credit checks from being run on it.
* Please note that the test flag is designed for onboarding only, and should not be used for any other purpose.
* Please also note that API calls are rate-limited to ***60 calls per minute***.


### How to Use This Documentation:


  * Expand an endpoint by clicking the arrow on the right-hand side.

    * When expanded, you will see:

      * **Example Value** – A sample request body showing how the payload should
        be structured.

      * **Schema** – Detailed information about each field, including:

        * The data type (string, integer, boolean, array, etc.)

        * Whether the field is required or optional

        * Any validation rules or constraints

        * Whether the field expects one of a predefined list of values


  * Some fields require values from a predefined list. For example, in
      **POST /application**, the `title_id` field must contain one of the
      supported values displayed in the Schema section. You may use any of the
      allowed values shown there when calling the endpoint.


### Retrieving Supported Values:


  Some endpoints return lists of supported values that must be used in other
    API calls.


  * **GET /application/document-types**

    Returns a list of all supported document types and their corresponding IDs.

    When this endpoint is called, it returns:

    * The supported document types

    * The unique ID associated with each document type


  * This information should then be used when calling:

      **POST /application/{application_id}/upload** to upload an application-related document.

    In the request body of this endpoint, the `document_type` parameter must
    match one of the IDs returned by the
    **GET /application/document-types** endpoint.



### Supported File Formats:
  Generally supported file formats include:

    bmp, doc, docx, gif, jpeg, jpg, pdf, png, xls, xlsx, xlx, heic, csv, msg, txt, eml




### Technical Support  

The Fleximize API is a self-service application, and all of the information you require to onboard should be collated below, however if you encouter any problems or have any questions and inquiries, please contact the development team using the link below. For all other non-technical enquiries, please contact your BDM.
